# AutoConvert Digital

> Marketing that just works. AutoConvert Digital fixes what happens after the click, so more of a business's leads become sales. Based on the Gold Coast, Queensland, working with businesses Australia-wide. Founded and run by Luke Wade.

## What we do

- The Click-to-Close Circuit™: a seven-stage system covering every step between someone clicking an ad and paying the invoice: Offer & Ads, Destination, Capture, Qualify, Engage, Close, Maximise.
- Meta Campaign Audit, $97: an expert audit of your Meta ads, offer, landing page and lead capture. Your score, your biggest leaks ranked by cost, and what to fix first, in 48 hours. https://autoconvertdigital.com.au/audit
- Strategy call: for businesses already running ads that want more revenue from their marketing. Apply here: https://autoconvertdigital.com.au/strategy-call
- Landing pages, lead capture and CRM set-up, speed-to-lead and follow-up automation, conversion copywriting.
